task_abi: Opaque 192-byte little-endian replay_task, bit zero is byte zero LSB. Field bit offsets are generated from replay_contract.json by tools/generate_replay_control_layout.py into rtl/replay/replay_control_layout_pkg.sv. Test rejects generated ABI drift.

queue.clock: clk, synchronous rst; control-domain requests must cross an external atomic CDC mailbox
queue.capacity: DEPTH elaboration parameter, default 4; queued_count excludes the one active task and held rejection disposition
queue.admission: push_valid is a command strobe. Registered push_accepted or push_rejected; full rejects reason 1, invalid bank/group reason 5, duplicate outstanding group/bank reason 15. Producer must already hold the bank replay reference and immutable task/profile references before submission.
queue.ownership: One bitmap bit per group/bank covers queued, active and rejected-awaiting-disposition lifetimes. Queue never writes RAW or emits a bank release token. Failed enqueue leaves all upstream references under producer ownership.
queue.dispatch: head_task/head_valid expose oldest immutable task. Root supplies head-specific live checker inputs and asserts evaluation_valid only when they refer to this exact head. dispatch_valid is an edge transfer strobe requiring reader_ready, fresh head_legal, no active reader and no held rejection. Connect directly to frozen_replay_reader task_valid; unpack task fields using generated offsets.
queue.retirement: retire_valid must denote the accepted real reader completion/cancellation token after last actual RAM read is drained and ownership disposition accepted, not merely dequeue, host completion, planned end or a software action. Match owner_epoch, generation, group, bank and task_id from tracked active task; stale/duplicate retire gives retire_rejected and cannot release occupancy.
queue.rejection: Illegal head is removed into rejected_task/reject_reason held until reject_ready. Consumer must disposition its replay and coefficient refs (no read was dispatched) before acknowledging; no queue-generated RAW release. Occupancy held until this acknowledgement.
queue.reset: External owner reset coordinator must quiesce/cancel/drain active reader and queued references before asserting rst. Reset is not a bank release protocol.
queue.physical_implementation: Portable bounded synchronous register-array FIFO. Catalog names XPM_FIFO_SYNC; this implementation does not instantiate XPM. Mapping to XPM/BRAM remains an integration/resource choice, with identical ownership and dispatch semantics required.

checker.input_context: current_owner_epoch/generation/config_id/fir_id/source_epoch and qualification/lease/source feedback must come from the bank selected by head_task; task_profiles_valid verifies retained rx_cal_id, tx_cal_id, target_matrix_id, reference_plane_id and doppler_phase_id and all other referenced versions, not just existence of a current profile.
checker.source: Primary external role=1 only in groups1..3; AUX external role=2 only group4 with explicit allow_aux_replay. Roles0/3/unknown and !source_stable are forbidden. AUX remains disabled by default at integration.
checker.time: Unsigned u64 500MHz GSC ticks; 4 ticks per 125MHz sample. first_output_gsc=target_gsc-reference_sample_index*4-downstream_latency_ticks. Require first>=gsc+8, matching low2 phase, no arithmetic wrap, and last sample within u64. No PRI ceiling. Integer reference scheduling mirrors frozen_replay_reader; nonzero fraction_q32 requires explicit fractional_supported and validated downstream timing.
checker.safety: data_ready and qualified cover full frozen capture plus statistics; guard_clear and planned_slot_clear must cover entire physical TX interval including tails/turnaround; unknown future schedule must not be represented as clear. rf_safe, binding_valid and resources_ready are current trusted hardware/resource decisions.
checker.while_active: Checker gates admission only. Existing reader retains its runtime abort/time-continuity logic, and RF safety interlock must remain continuously connected downstream.
